title: Access Control policy is pinned to the admitted session
summary: AlchemyAccessSessionGuard retains the exact Access Control policy identity that admitted a session. Before protected METHOD evaluation it verifies that the session is open and that the same admission policy remains operative.
invariants: Building admission is a session boundary, so an admitted session is pinned to the exact Access Control policy identity used at entry.
If that policy is unavailable, suspended, withdrawn, ineffective, or replaced by another operative identity, the old session fails closed.
Session invalidation occurs before Security Effect or Permission evaluation.
A policy transition requires fresh authenticated re-entry; it does not silently migrate an old admission.

provenance.claim: Access Control policy identity is pinned to the admitted session and changes require fresh authenticated re-entry; method Permission is intentionally live.
AlchemyAccessSessionGuard fails closed for closed session, unavailable admission policy, or changed admission-policy identity.
